env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^eject ok: gadget$'
stdout '^options: true true 7 true$'
stdout '^presence: true false 0 1$'
stdout '^chain: anon hi ann ann ann$'
stdout '^chainnil: bob anon anon anon$'
stdout '^log ann$'
stdout '^once: hi ann anon ann 4$'
stdout '^nested: true true 3$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
grep 'func H.*_logos_rt\.Option' out/main.go
grep '^func F\(\) \*User \{' out/main.go
grep '^func \(b \*Box\) Get\(\) \*T \{' out/main.go
! grep 'Option\[\*User\]' out/main.go
grep '^func N\(\) _logos_rt\.Option\[_logos_rt\.Option\[int\]\] \{' out/main.go
grep 'func I.*_logos_rt\.Option' out/main.go
grep 'func None\(\) Choice' out/main.go
grep '_logos_rt\.Option' out/main.go
! grep '\*User\?' out/main.go
! grep '\[\]int\?' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectopt

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type T struct {
	X int
}

func F() *User? {
	return &User{Name: "alice"}
}

type Box struct {
	P *T?
}

func (b *Box) Get() *T? {
	return b.P
}

func H() []int? {
	return nil
}

func PNil() []int? {
	m := map[string][]int{"n": nil}
	return m["n"]
}

func NNone() []int? {
	return nil
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func I() int? {
	return 7
}

func N() (int?)? {
	var i int?
	return i
}

func NSome() (int?)? {
	var i int? = 3
	return i
}

func (u *User) Greet(prefix string) string {
	return prefix + u.Name
}

func (u User) Pair() (string, int) {
	return u.Name, 7
}

func (u *User) Log() {
	fmt.Println("log " + u.Name)
}

type Team struct {
	Lead *User?
}

func FieldOf(u *User?) string {
	return u?.Name ?? "anon"
}

func CallOf(u *User?) string {
	return u?.Greet("hi ") ?? "anon"
}

func ChainOf(t *Team?) string {
	return t?.Lead?.Name ?? "anon"
}

func IndexOf(m map[string]*User) string {
	return m["a"]?.Name ?? "anon"
}

func VoidOf(u *User?) {
	u?.Log()
}

var recvCalls int

func Recv(present bool) *User? {
	recvCalls++
	if present {
		return &User{Name: "ann"}
	}
	return nil
}

func OnceOf() string {
	recvCalls = 0
	call := Recv(true)?.Greet("hi ") ?? "anon"
	absent := Recv(false)?.Greet("hi ") ?? "anon"
	Recv(true)?.Log()
	field := Recv(true)?.Name ?? "anon"
	return fmt.Sprintf("%s %s %s %d", call, absent, field, recvCalls)
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("eject ok: " + G(&User{Name: "gadget"}))
	fmt.Printf("options: %t %t %d %t\n", F() != nil, len(H() ?? []int{9}) == 1, I() ?? 0, None() == nil)
	fmt.Printf("presence: %t %t %d %d\n", PNil() != nil, NNone() != nil, len(PNil() ?? []int{9}), len(NNone() ?? []int{9}))
	fmt.Printf("chain: %s %s %s %s\n", FieldOf(nil), CallOf(&User{Name: "ann"}), ChainOf(&Team{Lead: &User{Name: "ann"}}), IndexOf(map[string]*User{"a": {Name: "ann"}}))
	fmt.Printf("chainnil: %s %s %s %s\n", FieldOf(&User{Name: "bob"}), CallOf(nil), ChainOf(nil), IndexOf(map[string]*User{}))
	VoidOf(&User{Name: "ann"})
	fmt.Printf("once: %s\n", OnceOf())
	fmt.Printf("nested: %t %t %d\n", N() != nil, (N() ?? I()) == nil, (NSome() ?? I()) ?? 0)
}

type A struct{}

func (A) Name() string { return "a" }

type B struct{}

func (B) Name() string { return "b" }

type Choice interface {
	A | B
	Name() string
}

func None() Choice? {
	return nil
}
